notes: Infinitive absolute הִמָּלֵט left unrepresented; the ASV writes no intensifier and 'should' is the finite verb's modal (rules 56, 17).
כִּי → 'than that' as the ASV's comparative recasting of the exceptive; both words one connective unit headed on 'that' (rule 55), 'than' the competing head.
אֵין → 'there is nothing' headed on the negation word (rule 50); לִי keeps 'for me' and טוֹב the comparative 'better'.
